title: OTP application callback never registered, so `mix run --no-halt` starts no server
evidence: mix.exs:4-7 has no application/0; `application: [extra_applications: [:logger], mod: {BookApi.Application, []}]` sits inside project/0, which Mix ignores for .app generation. Re-verified in a temp copy (Elixir 1.20.3): generated book_api.app has no {mod,...}; `mix run -e` printed Application.spec(:book_api, :mod)=[], Process.whereis(BookApi.Server)=nil, :gen_tcp.connect to PORT={:error,:econnrefused}
suggestion: Add `def application, do: [extra_applications: [:logger], mod: {BookApi.Application, []}]` and remove the key from project/0

title: README run instruction does not produce a running service
evidence: README.md:13 `mix run --no-halt` — with the mix.exs defect nothing listens on :4000
suggestion: Fix mix.exs; add a smoke step (curl /health) to README

title: Tests never exercise the HTTP layer, so the startup defect passed every mechanical gate
evidence: test/book_api_test.exs:12-33 calls BookApi.Store.* and BookApi.Server.validate/1 directly; no request is ever sent to the server
suggestion: Add a test that starts the app and requests /health and /books

title: Create returns the max(id) row, so concurrent creates can return the wrong book
evidence: lib/book_api/store.ex:39-44 last_id discards last_insert_rowid (separate sqlite3 process) and uses SELECT max(id)
suggestion: Use `INSERT ... RETURNING *` in one sqlite3 invocation

title: SQL built by string interpolation (quotes escaped, but no parameter binding)
evidence: lib/book_api/store.ex:14,18 interpolate q()/val() into SQL passed to the sqlite3 CLI
suggestion: Use a SQLite driver (exqlite/ecto_sqlite3) with bound parameters

title: 204 No Content response carries a `{}` body with Content-Length 2
evidence: lib/book_api/server.ex:97 returns {204, %{}}; server.ex:34-36 always encodes and sends the body

title: Hand-rolled HTTP server, JSON codec and sqlite3 shell-out instead of standard Elixir libraries
evidence: lib/book_api/json.ex, lib/book_api/server.ex:19-74, lib/book_api/store.ex:30-38; matches idiomatic=0.2 in scores.json
